<h1>Landscapes.<br>Data.<br><span>Discovery.</span></h1>
<p class="cgm-lead">Geomorphology and data science, brought together to investigate environmental processes and change.</p>
<p>We connect field observations, spatial data, statistics, and computational models to ask how landscapes work—and what their patterns can tell us.</p>

<div class="cgm-ribbon" aria-label="Lab areas"><span>Geomorphology</span><span>Data science</span><span>Statistical modeling</span><span>Spatial analysis</span><span>Field research</span></div>
<section class="cgm-section">
<div class="cgm-section-heading"><p class="cgm-eyebrow">Our approach</p><h2>Curiosity in the field.<br>Insight in the data.</h2></div>
<div class="cgm-intro"><p>The Computational Geomorphology and Modeling Lab brings quantitative and statistical approaches to questions about environmental processes. Coastal and aeolian systems are a major research focus; data science, statistical reasoning, and reproducible computation are central to how we work.</p><p>We combine field measurements and high-resolution topography with inferential statistics, machine learning, and time-series analysis to examine patterns, test hypotheses, and evaluate uncertainty.</p></div>
</section>
<section class="cgm-research-section">
<div class="cgm-section-heading"><p class="cgm-eyebrow">Research in motion</p><h2>Different questions.<br>Connected ways of thinking.</h2><p>Explore the systems we study and the analytical approaches we bring to them.</p></div>
<div class="cgm-cards">
<a class="cgm-card cgm-card-green" href="eco-geo-dunes.html"><span class="cgm-card-number">01 / EARTH SYSTEMS</span><h3>Landforms &amp;<br>sediment movement</h3><p>Beach–dune morphodynamics, aeolian transport, and the environmental drivers of geomorphic change.</p><span class="cgm-card-link">Explore geomorphology ↗</span></a>
<a class="cgm-card cgm-card-blue" href="turtles.html"><span class="cgm-card-number">02 / DATA &amp; MODELS</span><h3>Patterns &amp;<br>predictions</h3><p>Statistical modeling, spatial analysis, machine learning, and time series to understand complex environmental datasets.</p><span class="cgm-card-link">Explore our approaches ↗</span></a>
<a class="cgm-card cgm-card-sand" href="wrack.html"><span class="cgm-card-number">03 / ENVIRONMENTAL APPLICATIONS</span><h3>Habitats &amp;<br>natural infrastructure</h3><p>Sea turtle nesting habitat and beach wrack research connecting environmental patterns with management questions.</p><span class="cgm-card-link">Explore applications ↗</span></a>
</div>
</section>
<section class="cgm-methods-section">
<div class="cgm-section-heading"><p class="cgm-eyebrow">Inside the workflow</p><h2>How do we turn a question<br>into understanding?</h2><p>Open a method to explore how it fits into our research.</p></div>
<div class="cgm-methods">
<details open><summary><span>01</span> Observe &amp; measure</summary><p>Field measurements, LiDAR, UAS-derived surfaces, and terrestrial laser scanning help us document environmental conditions and landform morphology across space and time.</p></details>
<details><summary><span>02</span> Organize &amp; explore</summary><p>R and GIS support data management, visualization, spatial analysis, and reproducible workflows that make complex datasets easier to investigate.</p></details>
<details><summary><span>03</span> Model &amp; evaluate</summary><p>Inferential statistics, machine learning, and time-series analysis help us test hypotheses, explore nonlinear relationships, assess uncertainty, and evaluate model performance.</p></details>
<details><summary><span>04</span> Interpret &amp; communicate</summary><p>We connect analytical results to environmental processes and communicate what the evidence supports, including its limits and implications for environmental management.</p></details>
</div>
</section>
